title: 04 · Voltfield: live workout
strengths: The hierarchy is right for a glance mid-stride: one 169 px heart rate, its zone, the target range, then the trace and the strip, with Lap small and Pause wide (the Apple Fitness weighting).
Specific data: Tempo 6 × 800, rep 4/6, 496 / 800 m, zone times that add up, a coach cue with a pace window and a comparison to rep 3, 'Hold Pause to end the run'.
slop_signals: Glow on everything lime: a text-shadow bloom on '172', bloom on the trace line and its pink peaks, bloom on the Z4 segment and the active rep segment.
A faint 39 px grid drawn over the whole black background: texture with no meaning.
Chamfered corners on the lock, Lap and Pause, a skewed 'Z4 · THRESHOLD' chip and a skewed rep bar: three 'techy' shape tricks on one screen.
A red heart glyph beside 'BPM' as decoration; the zone bar already says what the colour means.
fixes: Remove every glow (text-shadow and zero-offset box-shadow); lime on black is 18:1 and needs no help.
Pick one shape rule: chamfers on the two buttons or the skew on the chip, not both; set the rep bar straight.
Drop the heart glyph; 'BPM' as a unit is enough.

references.what: Big heart rate over a live trace and a three-stat strip, all flat: the same stack with no glow or grid.
One yellow timer and a wide pause in a bottom tray; everything else is grey and small.
Zone arc, zone label and a big number on a flat dark gradient.
One giant slanted number on flat orange: loud without a single effect.
Zone ring with the active segment raised and labelled in plain words.
